name: 2B Chop Shop Dyno baseline
verdict: GENERALIZATION AUDIT PASSED. v2's 26.2% headline was dev-inflated. Corrected held-out accuracy on the same 1,100 trials: only few_single beats random chance on held-out (20.9%, binomial p < 10^-6 vs 4% baseline). The other three conditions are statistically at chance.

checkpoint.author: UnstableLlama
checkpoint.model_kind: INSTRUCT (Qwen3 ChatML, eos <|im_end|>, with <think></think> thinking tokens)

corrections_vs_v2.v2_claim_26_2_pct_as_held_out: WRONG. 26.2% was ALL 10 snippets x 50 seeds = 500 trials, NOT a held-out metric. v2 tuned prompts against DEV_SNIPPETS = {CWE-89 SQLi, CWE-79 XSS, CWE-22 path} and then averaged dev + held-out together.
corrections_vs_v2.scope_statement: The DEV and HELDOUT splits must be reported separately. Overall combined numbers remain for completeness only; the HELDOUT numbers are the real generalization signal.

g2_independent_scorer_agreement.scorer_b_path: docs/dyno/scorers/scorer_v2b.py (no regex; str.find + line-split + manual digit scan)
g2_independent_scorer_agreement.verdict: Both scorers extract the SAME CWE identifiers from all 2,100 scoring decisions. The 100% agreement validates that prior v2 metrics were not scorer artifacts. Rescoring did not change the numbers; it only revealed the dev/held-out confound.

g1_dev_vs_heldout_table_wilson.note: Wilson 95% CIs at the TRIAL level. For few_single we have 50 trials per snippet (so 150 dev + 350 held-out) at the trial level.

g3_item_level_uncertainty_bootstrap.note: Bootstrap 95% CIs computed OVER THE SNIPPETS (not the trials). This is the honest item-level CI; our sample is only 3 dev + 7 held-out distinct examples. The trial-level Wilson CI above is TIGHT because it treats 50 responses to one snippet as 50 independent events, which they are not.
g3_item_level_uncertainty_bootstrap.explicit_warning: With only 7 held-out examples the bootstrap CI for few_single stretches 2.6 - 44.0 percent. A single additional held-out example in the right category could swing the mean up or down by many points. These numbers are reproducible but have LOW statistical resolution.

g3_random_chance_check_heldout.finding: ONLY few_single beats random on held-out. The other three conditions cannot be distinguished from a 25-class uniform prior. This is a fundamental correction to v2's reported ordering.

g3_paired_mcnemar_heldout.note: Within-subject McNemar test on matched (seed, snippet) pairs. chi-squared with continuity correction; df=1.
g3_paired_mcnemar_heldout.summary: few_single beats every other condition significantly (p < 10^-11). zero_batched / few_batched / zero_single are pairwise indistinguishable on held-out.

g4_zero_category_probes_dev_only.methodology: Three alternative prompt styles (minimal / textbook / wiki) over three new dev paraphrases per CWE across 4 lowest categories (346, 434, 311, 347). 50 seeds each. 1,800 total model calls. HELD-OUT snippets never touched.
g4_zero_category_probes_dev_only.interpretation: 0% on these categories in v2 is a PROMPT KNOWLEDGE failure, not a model capability failure. With CWE definitions present in the prompt, the 2B model correctly identifies CWE-346, CWE-434, and CWE-311 in 90-100% of dev trials. CWE-347 (JWT signature verification) is harder (22%); the model recognizes 'JWT' but still often picks CWE-20 or CWE-287 instead of CWE-347. The 'wiki' style (showing unrelated example classifications) gave 0% — the model only copies categories it sees explicitly named.
g4_zero_category_probes_dev_only.implication_for_heldout: This finding is DEV-ONLY and does NOT change the v2.1 held-out numbers. It only tells us WHERE to look next if we ever extend the benchmark: a textbook-preamble prompt would almost certainly lift held-out accuracy substantially, but we cannot verify that without new held-out snippets.

scope_guards_honored: Did NOT rerun the 1100 trials (reused existing JSONL)
Did NOT touch the 7 held-out snippets during probe design
Did NOT start fine-tuning / DPO / QLoRA / RAG
Did NOT add new model sizes
Reported trial-level AND item-level uncertainty separately
Explicitly stated only 10 distinct examples; only 7 are held-out
graduation_status: NOT GRADUATED. Only ONE of four conditions beats random on held-out, and its item-level bootstrap CI on only 7 snippets is 2.6-44.0 percent. We cannot claim generalized capability from this sample.
